title: Meson mixing effects on the speed of sound in isospin-imbalanced matter
summary: We explore isospin imbalanced strongly interacting matter within the two-flavor Linear Sigma Model with quarks, an effective model for low-energy QCD. At one loop order, including quark, pion, and sigma fluctuations while respecting chiral symmetry, we find that the formation of an isospin condensate necessarily gives rise to a Goldstone mode. This mode enforces a nontrivial relation between the chiral and isospin condensates through the mixing of charged pions and the sigma field in the condensed phase.
